parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Minimum value: **1**. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned.

parameters.name: EndTimeStamp
parameters.description: The end time in timestamp format.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned by default. > Specify a value for the paging parameter.

parameters.name: SrcIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the attack source.

parameters.name: StartTimeStamp
parameters.description: The start time in timestamp format.

parameters.name: StatisticsType
parameters.description:
The type of attack source statistics information. Valid values:

- **TOP_ATTACKED_AGENT**: the top 5 probes by number of attacks.
- **TOP_ATTACKED_IP**: the top 5 IP addresses by number of attacks.
- **ATTACK_EVENT_TYPE**: the intrusion event type.
- **ATTACK_HONEYPOT_TYPE**: the type of the compromised honeypot.
